reason: OpenDesign is a local-first desktop design workspace that uses coding-agent runtimes to create and refine visual artifacts such as prototypes, dashboards, decks, documents, images, and video, with previews and file exports.

summaries.zh: OpenDesign 是一款本地优先的桌面设计工作台，可借助编码智能体创建和迭代原型、仪表板、演示文稿、文档、图像与视频，并支持预览和文件导出。
summaries.en: OpenDesign is a local-first desktop design workspace that uses coding agents to create and refine prototypes, dashboards, presentations, documents, images, and videos with previews and file exports.

capabilities: Generates web, desktop, and mobile prototypes, dashboards, presentations, documents, images, and video artifacts
Reads and writes project files through connected coding-agent CLIs and local workflows
Connects to external model services through BYOK or configured agent runtimes
Integrates with coding agents through MCP and native runtime adapters
Exports artifacts to HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4
